florida-msft.feesNote: No separate program fee, professional-development fee, or deposit itemized on the FinTech program page. Published In-state/Out-of-state figures arithmetically match UF 2026–27 graduate per-credit totals for 30 credits (rates already include listed mandatory fee components). Missing separate fee line ≠ 0.
florida-msft.period: As published on program page (arithmetically = UF 2026–27 graduate per-credit × 30 credits). Fall 2027 / AY 2027–28 billing rates not yet published — sticker may change.
florida-msft.notes: OPEN traditional 1-year track (external/intl) launches Fall 2027 — DISTINCT from florida-msf (classic MS Finance = UF undergrad combination only; accessRestricted). 30 credits; on campus Gainesville; 8-week modular; Fall entry only. Program page Costs: In-state $15,976 / Out-of-state $43,478 (verified 2026-10-26). Alias URL https://warrington.ufl.edu/graduate/masters-fintech/ shows same figures. Warrington graduate cost table does NOT yet list 'MS in Finance and Technology' as a row (MS Marketing shows identical OOS/in-state figures — do not assume identity of programs). Combination 4/5-yr track is UF Finance majors only — not this catalog id's primary path. STEM designation not stated on official FinTech pages → stem null. Living band not published for this program → livingCostBand null (UF SFA general 2026–27 grad living expenses exist campus-wide but are not program-tied).
florida-msft.duration: 1 year traditional master's (combination bachelor's/master's 4 or 5 years is UF-undergrad-only pathway)
florida-msft.accessNote: Traditional 1-year master's open to external applicants (business major preferred; other majors case-by-case). Combination track is UF on-campus undergrads only — do not conflate with florida-msf classic combo MSF.

deadlines.note: 1-year traditional Fall 2027 launch deadlines on program page. Separate intl-only deadline not posted on primary FinTech page as of asOf.
